about.title: About the Silver Tempest set
paragraphs: Pokémon TCG: Silver Tempest is a Sword & Shield expansion released on 11 November 2022. It has 215 cards: 195 in the main set and 20 secret rares. There are also 142 reverse holos.
Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 195 main set cards), the Master set (337 cards, adding the reverse holos) or the Grand Master set (all 357 cards, adding the 20 secret rares).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
